Triangle BGH is congruent to DEF. Line GH is parallel to AC, cutting both sides of triangle BAC internally. This enables application of VI.2 for proportionality BG:GA = BH:HC.

Second placement (Steps 7-10): Same triangle ABC. Point G' lies on segment AB (between A and B) with AG' = DE. Point H' lies on segment AC (between A and C) with AH' = DF. Triangle AG'H' is congruent to DEF. Line G'H' is parallel to BC, cutting both sides of triangle ABC internally. This enables application of VI.2 for proportionality AG':G'B = AH':H'C.

The two placements are independent constructions on the same triangle ABC, each establishing one proportional relationship. Both implicitly assume triangle DEF has sides no larger than corresponding sides of ABC (so constructed points fall between vertices). No spatial conflict arises between the two constructions.
